protocol.validation_rule: shortest window after TRAIN holding >=1/3 of attack incidents by first-event time
protocol.incident_home_rule: an incident belongs to the split of its first event
protocol.purge_rule: events of validation-born incidents that fall in the test period are excluded from the TEST evaluation population (they remain in the stream so entity state stays causal)

label_vault_log.purpose: final held-out evaluation of frozen decisions
classifier A/B: legacy pool rebuild + incident-grouped CV (whole-dataset incidents)

A_legacy_row_level_cv.label: DIAGNOSTIC / LEGACY: StratifiedKFold over ROWS (incident leakage across folds)

B1_incident_grouped_loio.label: DIAGNOSTIC: leave-one-incident-out (no incident on both sides of any fold)

B2_incident_grouped_5fold.label: DIAGNOSTIC: StratifiedGroupKFold(5, shuffle, seed 42) by incident

C_chronological_leakage_safe.label: LEAKAGE-SAFE: fit on validation incidents, evaluated once on held-out TEST events
C_chronological_leakage_safe.note: fit ONLY on validation-born incidents; a class absent from validation cannot be predicted, so its recall is 0 by construction (a data limitation, not a model result)

D_shipped_classifier_on_streaming_alerts.label: shipped classifier (trained on all 36 incidents): FALSE alerts are leakage-free; TRUE alerts are in-sample

limitations: PARTIAL held-out: the entity's own profile (per-entity mean/var/n) and extractor history were removed and its warm-up events were excluded from the shared counters.

The GLOBAL components (Isolation Forest, sequence autoencoder, StandardScaler, calibration curves, peer priors) of the shipped artifact were fitted on all 200 entities' training traffic and cannot be un-fitted without retraining, which ML-2 forbids. This is a cold-start experiment, NOT a clean held-out-entity generalisation test.

api_feature_parity.note: Diagnostic. Profiler frozen (no EWMA updates) so differences are purely representational. alert = risk >= shipped ML threshold

code_facts.api.py_session_duration: reads sessionDurationMinutes into session_duration (training data is in seconds)
code_facts.api.py_commands: reads commandSequence verbatim; features.py splits on '|'

dataset_shortcuts.note: DIAGNOSTIC. Single raw-field shortcuts; ORACLE_* use generator profile data the detector never sees.

streaming_runtime.note: wall-clock; depends on machine load and is NOT part of the reproducibility comparison

reproducibility.shipped_artifact_pickled_with_sklearn: 1.9.0 (load emits a version warning under the installed version)
